contract: A shorter members email. It keeps the stated cause (the chlorine pump failed), the replacement part expected Thursday on the vendor's word, the county health inspector's sign-off before reopening, Saturday as a target that is not promised, and the kids' pool open as normal. A vaguer cause such as "maintenance" loses a supported fact. No other cause, consequence or date is added. The Ohio origin, Monday and the kids' pool separate pump are supported and may be kept or dropped.
source_statements: The lap pool is closed this week.
The chlorine pump failed on Monday, and the replacement part has to ship from the manufacturer in Ohio.
The vendor says the part should arrive Thursday.
Once it is installed, the county health inspector has to sign off before the pool can reopen.
The target is Saturday, but it cannot be promised.
The kids' pool uses a separate pump and is open as normal.
legitimate_alternatives: Keep the cause in one short clause.
Drop Ohio, Monday or the separate pump detail.
Phrase Saturday as "aiming for", "hoping for" or "the target, not a promise".
